name: iNERTiA
source:
Story about dissociation, recovery, and the friends (imaginary or not) who help us survive. Guide Juno through her new life in Indigo Creek, build bonds that feel real, and uncover the facets of her psyche one by one.

[From [url=https://virtualskunk.itch.io/inertia]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
关于解离、恢复和帮助我们生存的朋友（无论是虚构的还是虚构的）的故事。引导朱诺度过她在靛蓝溪的新生活，建立感觉真实的纽带，并一一揭开她心灵的各个方面。

[来自[url=https://virtualskunk.itch.io/inertia]Itch.io[/url]]
